purpose: Determine whether the public MIT VTCode session corpus exposes a duplicate-safe native session coordinate through the harness representation before any browser-tool prevalence or overlap statistic is computed.

source.collector_semantics: Each source session file is copied as one redacted output file; JSONL sources are wrapped as a JSON object with a lines array. The collector does not concatenate source session files.
source.naturalness_basis: The pinned dataset card describes redacted coding-agent sessions exported from a local VTCode workspace. PRIVATE297 treats this as a natural-use candidate, not as proof that every session is a production task.

representation.reason: Harness logs are emitted from VTCode's authoritative ThreadEvent stream and predate ATIF export in this corpus; choosing only ATIF would create temporal coverage bias.

admissible_if_all_requirements_hold: pinned README still declares MIT license and local VTCode workspace session collection
at least two harness candidate files exist
every harness candidate exposes a nonempty native thread_id in its first logical thread.started event
unique native thread_id count equals harness file count
no native thread_id spans multiple harness files
no exact full-file-content duplicate group exists
decision_rule.pass_authorizes_only: A separate preregistered count-only screen of source-native VTCode browser tools.
